title.en: SAMPLE: Example Press retracts 84 papers with undisclosed AI text
title.zh: SAMPLE：Example Press 撤稿 84 篇含未揭露 AI 文字的論文

found.en: Example Press retracted 84 papers in nine journals. The text and images in these papers came from an AI tool that the authors did not disclose.
found.zh: Example Press 撤稿了九本期刊中的 84 篇論文。這些論文裡的文字和圖片，來自一個作者沒有揭露的 AI 工具。

matters.en: Other researchers may have cited these papers, so the harm can spread beyond the journals.
matters.zh: 其他研究者可能引用了這些論文，所以傷害可能擴散到期刊之外。

ai_helped.en: An AI tool made the text and images. The publisher's notices do not name the tool.
ai_helped.zh: 文字和圖片是由 AI 工具製作的。出版商的通知沒有說出這個工具的名稱。

how_sure.en: Checked. Example Press, the publisher of the papers, says so in its own statement and in two retraction notices.
how_sure.zh: 已查核。這些論文的出版商 Example Press，在自己的聲明和兩份撤稿通知中這麼表示。

background.en: A retraction notice tells readers that a paper should no longer be relied on.
background.zh: 撤稿通知是在告訴讀者，不應該再採信這篇論文。

could_lead.en: Publishers could check for undisclosed AI text before they accept a paper.
could_lead.zh: 出版商可能在接受論文之前，先檢查有沒有未揭露的 AI 文字。

evidence.quote: produced with an AI tool that the authors did not disclose
